campaign.title: Commutation of the two-axis beta transfer with renormalized radial-side exhaustion

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use the exact arbitrary-order radial endpoint recurrence, Stirling/gamma bounds, Mellin-profile decay, residue calculus, and the proved finite sixteen-stratum ledger. Search primary literature only if a genuinely nonstandard uniform contour-exhaustion theorem is needed; audit its hypotheses before use.

frozen_target.question: Does arbitrary-order endpoint subtraction make every one of the sixteen beta two-axis transfer images of the renormalized radial sides vanish under the already accepted nested S=S(X,U,V) exhaustion?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Use the fixed even mask psi in C_c^infinity(R), psi=1 on [-B0,B0] and supp psi subset [-2B0,2B0]. Let S_rad^(M)(U,V,S) be the upper-minus-lower radial-side functional with R_(M,v), and let X_uv be the proved finite sixteen-stratum transfer. First test the exact support separation |beta|>=S-(U+V)/2 on the reflected radial sides. If that does not close every stratum, prove lim_nested X_uv S_rad^(M)=0 for a single explicit sufficiently large M and polynomial nesting S(X,U,V), uniformly with all actual profiles, floors, stars, axial/artificial collisions, psi'/psi'' connectors, and the external normalization; or isolate one exact transferred stratum whose S-capacity cannot be removed. Do not address the endpoint/arithmetic physical-module commutator or a terminal-symbol estimate.
quantities: arbitrary-order R_(M,v) value and u/v derivative bounds on s=lambda+/-iS
pure u=0 and v=0 side residues and the joint corner
actual W_j, phi, D_j, H_j, h,q,m, chi_4, floors, and stars
artificial/axial collision residues under common ownership
degree-two left-edge capacity and outside Mellin norms
one explicit M and nested growth law S=S(X,U,V)

completion_criteria: Every sixteen-stratum side image is assigned an explicit S-power and U,V dependence.
Differentiation or residues of R_(M,v) are proved not merely asserted to retain arbitrary-order decay.
The same declared M and nested S(X,U,V) close all strata, or the first nonvanishing stratum is isolated.
Artificial/axial collisions and the corner are handled by a common residue convention.
The result is scoped to renormalized radial sides and does not claim physical endpoint/arithmetic commutation.
A statement-only blind derivation and hostile capacity audit independently assess the lemma.
The conductor closes the round before opening the physical-module commutator.

tasks.target: From the frozen statement and permitted endpoint-subtraction/finite-transfer syntheses, independently derive sufficient value, derivative, and residue bounds for R_(M,v) on s=lambda+/-iS. Build a sixteen-stratum S-power table and decide whether one M and polynomial nesting remove every transferred side image. If definitions are insufficient, identify the first exact missing bound. Do not read Round-35 claimant reports.
required_output: Independent transferred-side decay lemma or first missing coefficient
Complete sixteen-stratum S-power table and explicit nesting condition
Seven-section report at the assigned path

tasks.target: Insert the exact arbitrary-M radial remainder into every finite beta two-axis transfer stratum. Prove uniform S-decay for values, mask connectors, horizontal faces, axial and collision residues, and mixed terms with all actual Mellin profiles. Choose one explicit M and polynomial S(X,U,V) that kills the full side vector, or isolate the smallest surviving term and quantify its capacity.
required_output: Actual full-side transfer limit theorem or quantified survivor
Explicit M, S nesting, profiles, residue, collision, and normalization ledger
Seven-section report at the assigned path

tasks.target: Hostilely audit whether arbitrary-order radial decay survives all two-axis restrictions, residues, connector areas, and mixed derivatives. Search for S-power losses from gamma factors, axis collisions, moving sheared faces, U,V integration volumes, profile derivatives, or nonuniform constants. Either give a legal obstruction or certify the narrowest uniform exhaustion lemma with an explicit M and nesting law.
required_output: Counterexample or scoped certification with the weakest valid M and nesting hypotheses
Seven-section report at the assigned path

review_seams: S-powers of gamma quotients on all transferred faces
u/v restrictions, residues, and collision derivative costs
area-volume and profile-tail dependence on U,V
single explicit M and polynomial nesting law
uniformity in actual dyadic profiles, floors, stars, and normalization
strict separation from physical endpoint/arithmetic commutation
